meta.notes: Seeds grouped by the in-game rarity ladder Common -> Celestial. Income/cost/odds use the source display format (K/M/B/T). Many late-game (Divine/Exotic/Transcended) seeds have unconfirmed grow time, roll odds, or shop cost in public sources; those fields are left blank rather than guessed. Admin-only seeds (Admin Sunflower/Crownflower/Bloom/Starroot/Rose) are excluded as not normally obtainable. Event/limited-but-rollable seeds are kept with an origin acquisition note and no dates. Values drift with updates; treat as approximate.
